title: AER-1 ACP interop fixture — observation rows joined by name
description: Machine-readable observation rows for the pinned AER-1 corpus. Any implementation can run the same set, publish its own observer column joined on vector name, and state its compared scope honestly. The fixture carries its scope on its face; it does not claim conformance, certification, or that any described work happened.

observers.scope: compared rows only where pinned kit line carries per-vector verdict

contract.wideningRule: When a per-vector kit emit lands for remaining families, the column widens on evidence and the divergence count stays honest wherever it lands.
contract.comparisonRule: An observer column may only claim per-vector comparison where that per-vector verdict is actually measured; family-level-only lines remain unclaimed.
